title: Parameter
summary: Official Derivative reference for TouchDesigner parameters, covering parameter data types, parameter dialog access, evaluation modes, parameter attributes, custom parameters, internal parameters, and sequential parameters.
guidance: Use this article when a plan needs parameter semantics before choosing Parameter CHOP, Parameter DAT, Parameter Execute DAT, binding, or export workflows.
Every operator has control parameters, including numeric values, toggles, menus, text strings, operator paths, pulse buttons, and self-contained Python objects.
Do not treat a parameter object as the final value in scripts; use .eval() when the working value may come from constant, expression, export, or bind mode.
Parameter attributes such as name, label, default, range, menu entries, enable state, read-only state, and section dividers affect generated control panels and validators.
Custom parameters are distinct from built-in parameters and belong on Components, Custom Operators, and Script Operators.
